This plot is small and rented, so I will not spend my scarce money on chemical fertilizer or improved seed — those are too costly and risky for land that is not my own. I will spread some cow manure that my household has saved, because millet grows better with some nourishment and manure costs us nothing but labor. Since the rains have been unreliable and this millet must rely on what falls from the sky, I will not irrigate. My wife and children can manage the planting, weeding, bird scaring, and harvest on this small piece, so I will not hire anyone from outside.
